# Watchlist Match

> Watchlist Match is a free web tool that helps people figure out what to watch
> together. Enter two or more Letterboxd usernames and it compares the public
> watchlists, shows only the films on every list (the overlap, also called a
> watchlist blend), and sorts them by Letterboxd average rating with the genres
> shown for each film.

Watchlist Match is also known as a Letterboxd watchlist blend or watchlist
picker. It works with any number of usernames or profile links, only reads
public watchlists, stores nothing, and is not affiliated with Letterboxd.

## Links

- [Watchlist Match](https://www.watchlistmatch.com/): open the tool and compare watchlists
- [Letterboxd](https://letterboxd.com/): the film-logging site whose public watchlists are compared

## Details

- [How it works](https://www.watchlistmatch.com/): enter usernames, see the shared films sorted by rating
- Sorts shared films by Letterboxd member average rating
- Shows the release year and genres for each matched film
- Only public watchlists can be read; private profiles return an error
